documents.text:
WEB FORM - Make a complaint
Name: [CUSTOMER]
Account type: Current account
What is your complaint about? Card payment / refund
Tell us what happened:
On 20 June I ordered a corner sofa online from Larchmont Living and paid £1,349.00 in full on my H&V debit card ending [CARD]. Delivery was promised for the week of 10 August. It never came. My partner Sami took two days off work to wait in for it. They kept emailing to say there were delays at the factory. On 2 September they went into administration and the website just has a notice on it now. The administrators' letter says customers are 'unsecured creditors' and are unlikely to get anything back.

I contacted you on app chat on 10 September and asked for a chargeback. The person said you can't do chargebacks when a company has gone bust and I need to claim from the administrators. My friend got her money back from her bank for exactly the same thing, so I don't think that's right. I said I wasn't happy and was told to 'submit a complaint online', which is what I'm doing.
What would you like us to do? Raise a chargeback and refund the £1,349.
Best way to contact you: [EMAIL_1] (please use this one, not my old work email)

Card [CARD]. 20/06/2026 14:38 LARCHMONT LIVING LTD GBP 1,349.00 e-commerce, 3DS challenged, approved. Merchant status (scheme lookup 10/09/2026): TERMINATED - insolvency. 10/09/2026 16:22 Dispute enquiry via in-app chat, reason: goods not received. Agent outcome: NOT RAISED, 'merchant insolvent, refer cust to administrator'. Chat transcript note: customer wrote 'I'm not happy with this answer'. No complaint logged.

Web form complaint logged. Debit card purchase, goods not received, merchant in administration. Chargeback declined in chat 10/09. Chat shows cust said she was not happy on 10/09, TL to confirm whether received date should be 10/09. Called cust [CUSTOMER_PHONE] 22/09 10:15, no answer, no voicemail facility. To Payments & Disputes. - [STAFF]

relevant_policy.why_relevant: The customer's dissatisfaction with the chargeback refusal is a complaint and must be logged.

relevant_policy.why_relevant: Must check for earlier linked complaints before investigating. Only the 10 September chat is recorded, and it was not logged as a complaint.

citations.quote: Before investigating, the handler must check for earlier complaints from the same customer

relevant_policy.why_relevant: Sets the eight-week final response limit, which depends on the received date.

citations.quote: We must send a final response within eight weeks of receiving the complaint

relevant_policy.why_relevant: The received date and the chargeback outcome wording differ between records and must be recorded, not chosen.

citations.quote: Where system records disagree, for example on the date of a call or a payment

relevant_policy.why_relevant: The customer's requested outcome must be recorded in their own words.

citations.quote: The handler must record, in the customer's own words where possible, the outcome the customer is seeking.

relevant_policy.why_relevant: The case falls within the Payments and Disputes remit for card disputes and should be handed over with its checklist.

citations.quote: A complaint must be passed to a specialist team when it falls within that team's remit

relevant_policy.why_relevant: The customer must be told which team now holds the complaint, and this must be recorded.

citations.quote: The handler must tell the customer which team now has their complaint
